name: @statable/mcp

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: List the sites this API key can read. Response: {"sites":[{"site_id":123,"name":"<as entered by the owner — often a full URL like https://example.com/>","hash":"07k1eD84d2","timezone":"Europe/Amsterdam","hobby":false,"stats_start_date":"YYYY-MM-DD"|null,"created_at":"RFC3339"}]}. hobby=true is a free-plan site: it counts only through the bundled /t/ script get_tracking_snippet returns, so install that snippet verbatim. Use site_id with the other tools. With date_range each site also carries metrics NESTED under stats.metrics (never flat on the site object). Units: visit_duration = average seconds per visit; bounce_rate = percent 0-100; views_per_visit = pageviews/visits ratio; visitors/pageviews/visits = counts. Stats period boundaries are server-time approximations; use query_stats for timezone-exact numbers.

date_range.description: Optional. "7d"/"30d"/"month"/"realtime" or "Nd" for the last N days (1-90), e.g. "7d". Each site then gets {"stats":{"date_range":"7d","metrics":{"visitors":N,"pageviews":N,"visits":N,"visit_duration":seconds,"bounce_rate":percent0to100,"views_per_visit":ratio}}}.

tools.name: query_stats
tools.description: Run a read-only analytics query for one site: aggregate totals, a time series, or a top-N breakdown. Returns {"results":[{"dimensions":{...omitted for aggregates},"metrics":{...}}]}. All dates and time buckets are in the site's own timezone (see list_sites .timezone). The event:name breakdown lists custom events (data-statable-event); its `events` metric is the raw event count. The event:goal breakdown lists the site's configured goals with `visitors` (converters), `events` (conversions) and `conversion_rate` (percent). `events`/`conversion_rate` are breakdown-only (rejected on aggregate/time-series or a dimension that doesn't compute them). Units: visit_duration = average seconds per visit; bounce_rate = percent 0-100; views_per_visit = pageviews/visits ratio; visitors/pageviews/visits = counts.

site.description: Numeric site_id (preferred, from list_sites) or a domain, e.g. example.com — scheme, www. and path are ignored when matching. If several sites share the domain the call fails and lists their site_ids. Omit for a single-site key.

date_range.description: Preset "7d" or "30d" (last N full days), "month" (current calendar month to date; the first bucket may land on the prior month's last day), "realtime" (last ~30 min — pair with the time:minute dimension), "Nd" for the last N days (1..90, e.g. "14d"), or a custom inclusive ["YYYY-MM-DD","YYYY-MM-DD"] pair (over 90 days use a custom pair).

compare.description: "previous_period" (equal-length window before date_range) or a custom ["YYYY-MM-DD","YYYY-MM-DD"] pair. Adds a compare {value, change%} block: per-metric (aggregate), per-row (breakdown; not event:status_code/event:goal), or per-bucket (time-series). Time-series needs an equal-length range (else compare_length_mismatch).

dimensions.description: Zero = aggregate; one time dimension (time, time:hour, time:day, time:week, time:month) = time series; one breakdown dimension = top-N. Besides the enum you may also pass a dynamic 'event:props:<key>' dimension to break a custom event down by one of its property values (metrics visitors + events) — it REQUIRES an 'event' filter to name the event, e.g. dimensions:['event:props:plan'] + filters:[{field:'event',operator:'is',values:['Signup']}].

field.description: Field name WITHOUT the visit:/event: prefix. Values are the round-trip codes a breakdown returns as its dimension value: country/region take ISO codes (country = 2-letter alpha-2 like "US"), city takes a numeric geoname_id (the visit:city dimension value, e.g. "5128581"); page/entry_page/exit_page take URL paths like "/pricing". The 'event' field filters by a custom event name (an event:name breakdown value) and restricts the whole query to that event's sessions — it accepts ONLY operator "is" with a single non-standard value.

values.description: OR-ed together. Values may not contain commas.

tools.name: top_pages
tools.description: Top pages by visitors for a site. Returns {"results":[{"dimensions":{"event:page":"/path"},"metrics":{"pageviews":N,"visitors":N}}]}.

site.description: Numeric site_id (preferred, from list_sites) or a domain, e.g. example.com — scheme, www. and path are ignored when matching. If several sites share the domain the call fails and lists their site_ids. Omit for a single-site key.

period.description: "7d"/"30d", or any "Nd" = last N full days (N = 1..90); "month" = current calendar month to date. Default 30d.

tools.name: top_sources
tools.description: Top traffic sources by visitors for a site. Returns {"results":[{"dimensions":{"visit:source":"Google"},"metrics":{"visitors":N,"bounce_rate":percent0to100}}]}.

site.description: Numeric site_id (preferred, from list_sites) or a domain, e.g. example.com — scheme, www. and path are ignored when matching. If several sites share the domain the call fails and lists their site_ids. Omit for a single-site key.

period.description: "7d"/"30d", or any "Nd" = last N full days (N = 1..90); "month" = current calendar month to date. Default 30d.

tools.name: top_countries
tools.description: Top countries by visitors for a site. Returns {"results":[{"dimensions":{"visit:country":"US"},"labels":{"visit:country":"United States"},"metrics":{"visitors":N}}]} — the dimension value is the ISO alpha-2 code (drops straight into a country filter); the display name is in labels.

site.description: Numeric site_id (preferred, from list_sites) or a domain, e.g. example.com — scheme, www. and path are ignored when matching. If several sites share the domain the call fails and lists their site_ids. Omit for a single-site key.

period.description: "7d"/"30d", or any "Nd" = last N full days (N = 1..90); "month" = current calendar month to date. Default 30d.

tools.name: top_custom_events
tools.description: Top custom events (data-statable-event) by count for a site — pageview/engagement excluded. Returns {"results":[{"dimensions":{"event:name":"Signup"},"metrics":{"events":N,"visitors":N}}]}, where events is the raw occurrence count and visitors is unique users who triggered it.

site.description: Numeric site_id (preferred, from list_sites) or a domain, e.g. example.com — scheme, www. and path are ignored when matching. If several sites share the domain the call fails and lists their site_ids. Omit for a single-site key.

period.description: "7d"/"30d", or any "Nd" = last N full days (N = 1..90); "month" = current calendar month to date. Default 30d.

tools.name: top_goals
tools.description: The site's configured goals ranked by conversions. Returns {"results":[{"dimensions":{"event:goal":"Signup"},"metrics":{"visitors":N,"events":N,"conversion_rate":percent0to100}}]}, where visitors is unique converters, events is total conversions, and conversion_rate is visitors as a percent of all visitors in the period.

site.description: Numeric site_id (preferred, from list_sites) or a domain, e.g. example.com — scheme, www. and path are ignored when matching. If several sites share the domain the call fails and lists their site_ids. Omit for a single-site key.

period.description: "7d"/"30d", or any "Nd" = last N full days (N = 1..90); "month" = current calendar month to date. Default 30d.

tools.name: list_goals
tools.description: The goals CONFIGURED on a site — what it measures, not how those goals performed. Use top_goals for conversion numbers. Response: {"goals":[{"id":7,"name":"Signup","event_name":"Signup"|null,"path":"/thanks"|null,"operator":"e|b|c","scroll_depth":N|null}]}.

site.description: site_id from list_sites.

tools.name: list_prop_keys
tools.description: List the custom-property keys a site has recorded (with the event each belongs to) — discovery for the event:props:<key> breakdown in query_stats. Returns {"props":[{"key":"plan","event":"Signup","count":N,"first_seen":"RFC3339"}]}.

site.description: Numeric site_id (preferred, from list_sites) or a domain, e.g. example.com — scheme, www. and path are ignored when matching. If several sites share the domain the call fails and lists their site_ids. Omit for a single-site key.

period.description: "7d"/"30d", or any "Nd" = last N full days (N = 1..90); "month" = current calendar month to date. Default 30d. Or a custom ["YYYY-MM-DD","YYYY-MM-DD"] pair.

tools.name: list_funnels
tools.description: List the conversion funnels configured for a site (discovery — get a funnel_id for funnel_report). Returns {"funnels":[{"id":45,"name":"Signup flow","scope":"visitor","steps_count":3}]}.

site.description: Numeric site_id (preferred, from list_sites) or a domain, e.g. example.com — scheme, www. and path are ignored when matching. If several sites share the domain the call fails and lists their site_ids. Omit for a single-site key.

tools.name: funnel_report
tools.description: Run a saved conversion funnel and return its per-step result (NON-tabular). Returns {"funnel":{"id","name","scope"},"entering":N,"all_visitors":N,"steps":[{"index":0,"name":"Visited /pricing","kind":"page","visitors":N,"conversion_rate":percent0to100,"dropoff":N}, ...]}. steps are ORDERED; conversion_rate is cumulative vs the first step (entering), NOT step-to-step; dropoff is visitors lost vs the previous step. Get funnel_id from list_funnels first.

site.description: Numeric site_id (preferred, from list_sites) or a domain, e.g. example.com — scheme, www. and path are ignored when matching. If several sites share the domain the call fails and lists their site_ids. Omit for a single-site key.

period.description: "7d"/"30d", or any "Nd" = last N full days (N = 1..90); "month" = current calendar month to date. Default 30d. Or a custom ["YYYY-MM-DD","YYYY-MM-DD"] pair.

filters.description: Optional SEGMENT filters (session-level only: country/browser/os/device/source/channel/utm_*/entry_page/exit_page/hostname). Event-level fields are rejected.

tools.name: current_visitors
tools.description: Realtime count of unique visitors active in the last 5 minutes for a site. Returns {"site_id":123,"visitors":N}.

site.description: Numeric site_id (preferred, from list_sites) or a domain, e.g. example.com — scheme, www. and path are ignored when matching. If several sites share the domain the call fails and lists their site_ids. Omit for a single-site key.

tools.name: visitors_over_time
tools.description: Daily visitors and pageviews time series for a site, in the site's own timezone. Returns {"results":[{"dimensions":{"time:day":"YYYY-MM-DD"},"metrics":{"visitors":N,"pageviews":N}}]}.

site.description: Numeric site_id (preferred, from list_sites) or a domain, e.g. example.com — scheme, www. and path are ignored when matching. If several sites share the domain the call fails and lists their site_ids. Omit for a single-site key.

period.description: "7d"/"30d", or any "Nd" = last N full days (N = 1..90); "month" = current calendar month to date. Default 30d.

tools.name: get_tracking_snippet
tools.description: The script tag to install on a site, and the url it loads. Response: {"site_id":123,"type":"default","script_url":"https://...","snippet":"<script ...></script>"}. Install snippet verbatim; do not rebuild a tag from script_url. A hobby site's snippet also carries data-id, which is the only place the counter in its bundle reads the site id. Read-only: it reports the code, it does not install or verify anything.

site.description: site_id from list_sites.

type.description: Optional bundle variant; omit for the default script.

tools.name: get_site_filters
tools.description: Who gets counted on a site, and who may look at the stats. Response: {"site_id":123,"hostnames":{"allowed":[],"blocked":[]},"blocked_ips":["1.2.3.4"],"countries":{"allowed":[{"code":"UA","created_at":"RFC3339"}],"blocked":[]},"public_dashboard":false}. An empty allowed list means "no restriction", not "nothing allowed". public_dashboard true means the stats are readable by anyone with the link.

site.description: site_id from list_sites.

tools.name: get_subscription
tools.description: The account's plan state — not a site's. Response: {"status":"trialing"|"active"|"past_due"|"expired"|"trial_expired"|"none","is_trial":true,"ends_at":"RFC3339","only_hobby":false}. ends_at is when the CURRENT state stops being true (trial end while trialing, period end otherwise) and is omitted when unknown. status "none" with only_hobby true means a free account, not a missing one. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: create_site
tools.description: Add a site to this account and get back its id and tracking code. Response: {"site_id":123,"name":"https://example.com","timezone":"Europe/Amsterdam",...}. The url must include the scheme. A url this account already has is REFUSED (site_exists) rather than returned — two sites collecting the same traffic is worse than an error. Retrying with the same arguments replays the first result instead of creating a second site. Follow with get_tracking_snippet to obtain the script tag to install.

timezone.description: Optional IANA name, e.g. "Europe/Amsterdam". Defaults to the account's.

hobby.description: Optional. Request the free hobby tier; only certain domains qualify.

tools.name: update_site
tools.description: Change a site's url, timezone or week start. Omitted fields are left alone. Returns the updated site. Changing the url to one this account already has is refused (site_exists).

site.description: site_id from list_sites.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Add a goal to a site. A goal is EITHER a custom event (event_name), OR a page (path with operator), OR a scroll depth — give one of the three, not several. operator: "e" exact, "b" begins with, "c" contains. A duplicate name is refused (goal_exists).

site.description: site_id from list_sites.

event_name.description: Custom event to count, e.g. "Signup". Use list_prop_keys or top_custom_events to see what the site already sends.

path.description: Page path, e.g. "/thanks". Pair with operator.

operator.description: How path is matched: e exact, b begins with, c contains.

tools.name: update_goal
tools.description: Replace a goal's definition. Send the whole goal, not just the changed fields — omitted fields are cleared, not kept.

site.description: site_id from list_sites.

tools.name: create_funnel
tools.description: Add a funnel: an ordered list of 2+ steps. Each step is one of {"type":"page","value":"/pricing"}, {"type":"event","value":"Signup"}, {"type":"entry_page"|"exit_page","value":"/"}. An exit_page step must be last. scope "visitor" (default) or "session". A duplicate name is refused (funnel_exists). Read the result with funnel_report.

site.description: site_id from list_sites.

strict_order.description: Steps must occur in exactly this order with nothing between.

tools.name: update_funnel
tools.description: Replace a funnel's definition. Send the whole funnel including every step — omitted steps are removed, not kept.

site.description: site_id from list_sites.

tools.name: get_tracking_settings
tools.description: What the installed script actually does: which tracking features are on, which exist, and what each costs in bytes. Response: {"site_id":123,"version":N,"bundle":"...","enabled":["hash","outbound"],"features":[{"id":"outbound","label":"...","enabled":true,"locked":false,"default":false,"requires":[...],"size_br":123}]}. Locked features cannot be changed; `requires` lists features that must be on for this one to work. Needs the same access as changing them (see update_tracking_settings).

site.description: site_id from list_sites.

tools.name: update_tracking_settings
tools.description: Set which tracking features the site's script includes. REPLACES the whole selection: send every feature you want enabled, not just the new one — anything omitted is turned off. Call get_tracking_settings first for the valid ids. Rebuilds and republishes the script, so the change reaches visitors after the CDN cache clears.

site.description: site_id from list_sites.

features.description: Feature ids to enable, from get_tracking_settings. The complete list, not a delta; [] disables every optional feature.

tools.name: update_site_filters
tools.description: Change who gets counted, and who may look. Send only the sections you want to change — an omitted section is left untouched. A section you DO send replaces that setting entirely: {"countries":{"blocked":["RU"]}} also clears the country allow list, and {"blocked_ips":[]} empties the blocklist. Read the current state with get_site_filters and send it back with your edit applied. Filtering takes effect on new traffic; it does not remove data already collected. Answers with the resulting state plus "updated":["hostnames",...] naming what changed.

site.description: site_id from list_sites.

hostnames.description: Replaces the hostname lists. Allowed non-empty = count only these.

countries.description: Replaces the country lists. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, e.g. "UA".

public_dashboard.description: true makes the stats readable by anyone with the link.
